import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert StichtagDat to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a count plot of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='Rasse1Text', data=data)
plt.title('Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_breeds.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of dog age distributions
data['AlterV10Sort'] = pd.cut(data['AlterV10Sort'], bins=[0, 5, 10, 20, 30, 100])
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='AlterV10Sort', data=data)
plt.title('Dog Age Distribution in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_ages.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a stacked bar chart of dog sex distributions by year
data['SexSort'] = data['SexSort'].map({'1': 'männlich', '2': 'weiblich'})
data['Year'] = data['StichtagDatJahr']
data_grouped = data.groupby(['Year', 'SexSort']).size().unstack()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.heatmap(data_grouped, annot=True, cmap='Blues', fmt='d')
plt.title('Dog Sex Distribution in Zurich by Year')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('Sex')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_sex.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of top 10 districts by dog count
data_grouped = data.groupby('KreisLang')['HID'].count().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='KreisLang', y='HID', data=data_grouped.nlargest(10))
plt.title('Top 10 Districts by Dog Count in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('District')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_districts.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
